evals.prompt: Preview moving Cursor project skills and rules to Claude Code for /tmp/acme-app. No writes or unrelated discovery. Give the exact first command.
evals.expected_output: A scoped profile-aware project plan with no artifact or target writes.
assertions: Uses plan --source cursor/ide --target claude/code-cli --workspace /tmp/acme-app --scope project --objects skills,instructions --json.
Omits --output and --yes because this request forbids all writes.
Inspects only selected products, project surfaces, and the named workspace.
Preserves rule activation/hierarchy and reports conflicts or reconstruction instead of flattening them.

evals.prompt: In an isolated project workspace, preview Cursor MCP from evals/files/cursor-project-mcp.json to Cline. Show the saved-plan preview and apply commands, preserving unrelated target settings and removing literal credentials.
evals.expected_output: An exact Cursor-to-Cline project MCP plan and a separate reviewed-plan execution command.
assertions: Stages the supplied fixture in the isolated workspace at .cursor/mcp.json rather than using unsupported --source-mcp-file.
Uses plan --source cursor/ide --target cline/ide --scope project --objects mcp --output and apply <same-plan> --manifest --yes.
The proposed apply command uses --accept-loss for the reviewed MCP item when credential redaction makes it ready-lossy; --yes alone does not accept conversion losses.
Shows target mcpServers and preserves unrelated sibling settings; explains that the selected server map is replaced, removing target-only servers and replacing same-name definitions.
Reports added, removed, and changed same-name servers separately from conversion/redaction losses; an empty loss_report does not prove preservation of existing servers.
Redacts credential-looking values into references/loss reports without printing them.
Does not request repeated confirmation after the user explicitly authorizes applying the reviewed plan.

evals.prompt: Preview moving user Continue YAML MCP into Codex project config at /tmp/atlas. Do not read or write real files. Give only safe diagnostics and the next step.
evals.expected_output: A manual reconstruction route for unsupported YAML-to-TOML MCP without filesystem inspection.
assertions: Identifies Continue YAML and Codex TOML as requiring dedicated reviewed adapters.
Does not execute detection, inventory, or file reads because the user forbids real inspection.
Fabricates no JSON fallback or writable target snippet.
Explains native reconstruction and credential resupply without claiming migration or requesting installation.

evals.prompt: In an isolated workspace, run Cursor-to-Cline project MCP migration using evals/files/cursor-project-mcp.json. Save and review a plan, then apply it with --yes and verify. I approve replacing literal tokens with environment references; keep the source bytes unchanged and save the manifest.
evals.expected_output: Execution evidence for scoped preview, exact-plan apply, target validity, source integrity, and verification.
assertions: Uses real profile-aware commands against isolated temporary project surfaces, never real agent settings.
Proves target absence after planning and appearance only after authorized apply.
Replays the exact saved plan with a fresh manifest output path.
Accepts only the explicitly authorized credential-redaction losses using the saved plan item ID; reports or defers any other unapproved conversion losses.
Runs verify --manifest and reports applied counts, parse/hash results, losses, backups, and unchanged source.
Does not invent legacy evidence.mcp fields or pause for redundant approval.

evals.prompt: Explain Cursor mcp.json and its root key only. Do not inspect files, migrate, or give changing commands.
evals.expected_output: A concise informational answer outside the migration workflow.
assertions: Treats the request as explanation rather than migration authority.
Identifies mcpServers as the root key.
Claims no local read or script execution.
Provides no --yes/apply command or unrelated discovery.

evals.prompt: My saved Cursor-to-Cline project MCP plan targets an existing config with unrelated theme, a same-name server, and other servers. Explain the diff and backup/rollback behavior without executing.
evals.expected_output: Accurate profile-aware shared-config and guarded rollback semantics.
assertions: Explains preservation of unrelated sibling settings, removal of target-only servers, and replacement of same-name definitions with the reviewed source configuration.
Reviews additions, removals, and same-name configuration changes even when loss_report is empty.
Identifies transaction backups and the exact checksummed apply manifest.
Does not invent public --strategy skip/backup/overwrite support or renamed fallback entries.
Explains that rollback refuses targets changed after apply.
Does not execute or claim migration.

evals.prompt: Preview Claude Code user MCP to VS Code with a named Profile whose directory I did not provide. Do not guess a path or write. Give the safe next step and project alternative.
evals.expected_output: A bounded VS Code profile reconstruction path with a documented workspace alternative.
assertions: Distinguishes claude/code-cli, copilot/vscode, and copilot/cli.
Does not guess a user VS Code MCP path; uses MCP: Open User Configuration or asks for the resolved profile location.
Identifies .vscode/mcp.json as the project alternative with servers.
Keeps all actions within preview scope and reports unsupported user-surface reconstruction.

evals.prompt: Preview Cursor project MCP from evals/files/cursor-project-mcp.json into native OpenCode V2 for /tmp/opencode-v2. No writes or mixed V1/V2 layout. Show the safe command and reconstruction boundary.
evals.expected_output: A truthful OpenCode V2 manual route where the public Registry has no writable MCP surface.
assertions: Checks opencode/cli surface eligibility before promising automatic MCP apply.
Uses a profile-aware plan or explicit read-only legacy dry-run; never an implicit legacy write.
Does not advertise --opencode-version or --source-mcp-file as public plan/apply flags.
Explains native mcp.servers reconstruction with no V1 sibling map and no unvalidated target write.
Reports that product format knowledge does not prove an implemented automatic adapter.

evals.prompt: Back up Cursor project Skills, rules, and MCP from /tmp/old-project to /tmp/project.acb. Include no other products or user files; verify the backup.
evals.expected_output: A scoped portable ACB directory with collection and integrity evidence.
assertions: Uses explicit source cursor/ide, scope project, object selection, and output path.
Captures complete eligible Skill packages and authorized instruction/MCP objects only.
Runs bundle-verify and reports files captured, exclusions/failures, and checksum/binding evidence.
Calls .acb a directory rather than claiming compressed archive output.
Requires neither target apply nor repeated approval for the explicitly requested backup artifact.

evals.prompt: Restore this Cursor project ACB into Claude Code at /tmp/new-project. Save /tmp/restore-plan.json first, then apply that reviewed plan. There is no Cursor installation on the new computer.
evals.expected_output: A bundle-backed destination-side plan and verified restore independent of local source installation.
assertions: Resolves source selectors from the bundle and target claude/code-cli.
Uses restore --plan-out --plan-only, reads destination diffs, then restore --plan-in --yes with the same selectors and scope.
Uses bundle bytes as the source and preserves destination state guards across processes.
Reviews the stable acb_uri and bundle_source manifest binding; rejects a different bundle and preserves the saved plan bytes on replay.
Defers or asks about unapproved conversion losses; --yes alone never authorizes them, and --include lossy is used only for approved losses.
Reports applied counts and verify evidence; extraction or zero-applied output alone is not completion.
Retains scoped restore authorization without asking again solely because planning finished.

evals.prompt: Create a fresh signing keypair for this ACB, sign it, and verify it with my independently supplied public key. Everything must stay offline.
evals.expected_output: Offline signing artifacts and a separately reported trusted-key verification result.
assertions: Uses bundle-keygen with distinct fresh outputs, bundle-sign --key, and bundle-verify --trusted-key.
Requires already installed cryptography and reports unavailable signing without downloading dependencies.
Protects the raw private key and avoids storing it inside the bundle.
Rejects a mismatched independently trusted public key instead of trusting the embedded key.
Distinguishes checksum integrity from authenticated signature verification.

evals.prompt: Run doctor on this ACB and tell me what the new computer needs. Do not install, authenticate, or contact services.
evals.expected_output: Offline dependency, reauth, and reconstruction diagnostics within the bundle scope.
assertions: Runs doctor on the selected bundle after integrity validation.
Reports missing executables and all recorded packages, extensions, manual_installs, and platform requirements, alongside reauth/rebuild actions.
Does not equate PATH availability with package installation or runtime acceptance.
Does not execute MCP commands, install packages, contact servers, or print credential values.

evals.prompt: I am switching computers. Back up portable context for all detected installed IDEs, including configured-only profiles I explicitly selected, then review restoring onto installed target IDEs.
evals.expected_output: Device-wide detection, opt-in snapshot eligibility, and a reviewable multi-target restore plan.
assertions: Treats this request as authorization for device-wide discovery and backup, not unrelated configuration changes.
Reviews detection evidence and uses --all-installed with explicitly authorized --include-configured.
Uses fresh bundle output and scopes appropriate to requested personal/project context.
Saves the multi-target restore plan, reports conflicts/failures and deferred/manual work, and does not claim restored from preview alone.

evals.prompt: Back up a compatible plugin package and a reviewed handoff summary to ACB, then restore those selected objects. Exclude raw conversation, tokens, hooks activation, and generated memory.
evals.expected_output: Explicit plugin/handoff opt-ins with package preservation and whitelisted handoff fields.
assertions: Requires plugins with --include-plugins and handoff with --include-session on snapshot and restore/apply.
Checks compatible Registry surfaces rather than inventing plugin or session paths.
Preserves package contents as units without installation or activation.
Serializes only reviewed summary, git branch, relative selected file list, and explicit patch; does not transfer raw state.
Reports unsupported objects as reconstruction/exclusion rather than silent success.
